The data table has 27 rows with columns: dose, t, E. Your model will be used to predict the biomarker time course at 60 mg and 1000 mg.

PARAMS = ['E0','Imax','IC50','kout']
def predict(df, p):
    from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
    out = np.zeros(len(df))
    for dose, idx in df.groupby('dose').groups.items():
        sub = df.loc[idx]
        ts = np.sort(np.unique(sub['t'].values))
        tg = np.concatenate([[0], ts])
        C = pk_conc(dose, tg)
        E0, Imax, IC50, kout = p['E0'], p['Imax'], p['IC50'], p['kout']
        kin = E0*kout
        Cf = lambda t: np.interp(t, tg, C)
        def rhs(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            return [kin*(1 - Imax*c/(IC50+c)) - kout*y[0]]
        sol = solve_ivp(rhs, [0, ts.max()], [E0], t_eval=ts, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8)
        m = dict(zip(ts, sol.y[0]))
        out[df.index.get_indexer(idx)] = [m[t] for t in sub['t'].values]
    return out

def predict(df, p):
    from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
    out = np.zeros(len(df))
    for dose, idx in df.groupby('dose').groups.items():
        sub = df.loc[idx]
        ts = np.sort(np.unique(sub['t'].values))
        tg = np.concatenate([[0], ts])
        C = pk_conc(dose, tg)
        Cf = lambda t: np.interp(t, tg, C)
        E0, Emax, EC50, ke0, h = p['E0'], p['Emax'], p['EC50'], p['ke0'], p['h']
        def rhs(t, y):
            return [ke0*(Cf(t) - y[0])]
        sol = solve_ivp(rhs, [0, ts.max()], [0.0], t_eval=ts, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8)
        ce = np.maximum(sol.y[0], 0)
        eff = E0*(1 - Emax*ce**h/(EC50**h+ce**h))
        m = dict(zip(ts, eff))
        out[df.index.get_indexer(idx)] = [m[t] for t in sub['t'].values]
    return out

PARAMS = ['E0','Imax','IC50','kout','n']
def predict(df, p):
    # indirect response with n-compartment transit delay (mean delay n/ktr), inhibiting production
    from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
    out = np.zeros(len(df))
    n = int(round(p['n'])) if round(p['n'])>=1 else 1
    for dose, idx in df.groupby('dose').groups.items():
        sub = df.loc[idx]
        ts = np.sort(np.unique(sub['t'].values))
        tg = np.concatenate([[0], ts])
        C = pk_conc(dose, tg)
        Cf = lambda t: np.interp(t, tg, C)
        E0, Imax, IC50, kout = p['E0'], p['Imax'], p['IC50'], p['kout']
        ktr = n*kout
        def rhs(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            # y[0..n-1] transit, y[n] = E ; kin input = E0*kout*(1-I)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            ys = y
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            prod = E0*kout*(1-I)
            dy[0] = ktr*(prod*0 + 0) if False else 0
            return None
        # simpler explicit system
        def rhs2(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            E = y[n]
            dy[0] = (E0*kout*(1-I)*0) # placeholder
            return dy
        # Use: transit chain A_1..A_n with A_0 = E0, drive production by kin=E0*kout*(1-I) into chain
        def rhs3(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            # y[0]=E (response); y[1..n] transit states
            dy[1] = ktr*(E0*(1-I)*kout*0 + 0)  # unused
            return dy
        # Final clean formulation: delayed production
        def rhs_final(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            dy[0] = ktr*y[n] - kout*y[0]
            for k in range(1, n):
                dy[k] = ktr*(y[k-1]-y[k])
            return dy
        # transit chain: y[0]=E, y[1..n] are transit states driven by inhibition
        def rhs_chain(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            prod_in = ktr*E0*(1-I)  # input into first transit
            dy[1] = ktr*0
            return dy
        # Use plain formulation below
        def rhs_plain(t, y):
            c = Cf(t)
            I = Imax*c/(IC50+c)
            dy = np.zeros(n+1)
            # y[1..n] transit chain (y[n] feeds production of E)
            dy[1] = ktr*(E0*kout*(1-I) - y[1])
            for k in range(2, n+1):
                dy[k] = ktr*(y[k-1]-y[k])
            dy[0] = ktr*y[n] - kout*y[0]
            return dy
        y0 = np.concatenate([[E0], E0*np.ones(n)])
        sol = solve_ivp(rhs_plain, [0, ts.max()], y0, t_eval=ts, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8)
        m = dict(zip(ts, sol.y[0]))
        out[df.index.get_indexer(idx)] = [m[t] for t in sub['t'].values]
    return out
